title: Integral Half-Turn Landing Stair
description: One newly authored continuous static half-turn stone stair module. Six rectangular treads ascend one straight flight to a full-width rectangular intermediate landing; a second parallel straight flight reverses direction and rises through six more rectangular treads to the upper terminal. The landing crosses a real open-front central slot, connecting the two flights as one closed grounded stone mass with no internal duplicate cells, floating treads or overlaid riser pieces. This differs from existing annular90/270degree winder stairs, which turn on radial wedge treads without a full reversing landing, and from the single-flight boarding stair cart. One modular model, zero scenes. Stone body and full upward treads/platform use two opaque constant PBR face materials. Native metres, horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. No building, rails, passengers, copied steps or site scenery. Static illustrative geometry only; no pedestrian suitability, code compliance, accessibility, railing protection, actual load, host fit, installation or safety claim.
